Example Rules

1. Agreement

By taking part you agree to these example rules. Contact [email protected] with questions.

2. Submissions

Each team may make up to two official submissions per board in the final phase. Format checks do not count against this limit, and a file that fails validation is rejected before scoring so it does not use an attempt; the portal reports the first failing check in plain words and the upload can be repeated as often as needed until the file passes.

  • Files must be AnnData.
  • Cells must be within the board bounds.
